activity_02_daily.title: 7 Daily Challenges
activity_02_daily.conditionHtml:
1. Nov 12: earn a Barrel Roll Skill.
  2. Nov 13: complete a Dirt Race.
  3. Nov 14: earn at least 1 star from Drift Zones.
  4. Nov 15: earn a Showoff Skill.
  5. Nov 16: redeem a Wheelspin or Super Wheelspin.
  6. Nov 17: drive 10 miles (16.1 km).
  7. Nov 18: earn at least 1 star from Trailblazers.
Reward: 20,000 CR per challenge.
activity_02_daily.howHtml: Complete the objective on its scheduled day.
